Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable array (MS_MUTABLE_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
A final static field references an array
   and can be accessed by malicious code or
        by accident from another package.
   This code can freely modify the contents of the array.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring a public final static array named DEFAULT_VALUES. This array can be accessed and modified from outside the class, leading to potential security issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the'showBug' method with a new array, which modifies the static array 'DEFAULT_VALUES'. The test then asserts that the static array has been changed, thus triggering the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results confirm that the static array DEFAULT_VALUES was modified when the showBug method was called with new values. The assertion in the test checks that the original values are not equal to the modified values and that the new values match the modified static array, indicating that the bug was triggered.
